profile_text.body:
Read is a for-profit startup founded in 2020 and headquartered in Redwood City, CA. The company describes itself as an AI copilot that transforms meetings, emails, and messages into summaries, insights, and instant answers across devices. Its core product, Read.ai, functions as an AI meeting assistant offering real-time transcription, smart summaries, and AI-powered search and discovery across meetings, messages, emails, CRM data, and documents.

Read.ai is positioned as platform-agnostic, connecting across a range of third-party tools to provide what the company describes as unified insights. The product also incorporates meeting analytics, engagement scoring, wellness insights, and behavioral data privacy features. The company's site emphasizes that its integrations are central to the quality of its AI output, framing broad content and context access as a prerequisite for useful AI assistance.

The held facts note no litigation on record. Read.ai appears in the site's product registry under the Notes, Knowledge, and Meetings category.
